problem:
Find the left-sided limit at $x=0$ for the function

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tan}⁡x & \text{ for }\,-\frac{\pi }{2}<x\le 0 \\ {log}_{2}⁡x & \text{ for }\,x>0.\end{aligned}
$$

feedback.worked_solution:
Approaching from the right, we have $x>8,$ so we use the expression $f(x)=\sqrt[3]{x}+2.$ We get

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to {8}^{+}}f(x) & ={lim}_{x\to {8}^{+}}(\sqrt[3]{x}+2) \\  & =\sqrt[3]{8}+2 \\  & =2+2 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$
